department: MD Anderson UTHealth Houston Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences (GSBS) — Biomedical Sciences Ph.D.

deadline.value: For Fall 2027 entry, the priority and final deadline for international PhD Biomedical Sciences applicants is November 1, 2026 (domestic final deadline is December 1, 2026).

also.quote: Applications for Fall 2027 for the PhD programs (Biomedical Sciences and Medical Physics) and SMS programs (Genetic Counseling and Medical Physics) are now available!

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for biomedical sciences, and GSBS does not consider GRE scores.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is neither required nor recommended as part of the application. GRE scores are not taken into consideration by the Admissions Committee when reviewing an application.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Umbrella admissions: entering PhD students are admitted directly to GSBS without a prior faculty advisor and complete three tutorial rotations before selecting a mentor.
supervisor.quote: Students are admitted directly to the graduate school through an umbrella admissions process and not into departments or programs. Entering PhD students perform three tutorial rotations before selecting a faculty advisor and joining a graduate program.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students receive a Graduate Research Assistantship (GRA) with a $41,500 annual stipend (effective Fall 2026), full tuition and required fees payment, and health insurance benefits.
funding.quote: Graduate Research Assistantships (GRA) are provided to all PhD students. These assistantships require no service other than degree-related academic activities and include:

also.quote: Payment of the student’s tuition and required fees

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree or higher is required for PhD admission (recommended cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher).

notes: Umbrella Ph.D. in Biomedical Sciences covering Cancer Biology, Genetics & Epigenetics, Immunology, Microbiology & Infectious Diseases, Molecular & Translational Biology, and Therapeutics & Pharmacology.
